         function klevufejs_getCookie(name) {
             if (typeof (name) === "undefined") {
                 name = "klv_mage";
             }
             var c = "",
                 ca = document.cookie.split(';');
         
             for (var i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
                 c = ca[i];
                 if (typeof c !== "string") {
                     continue;
                 }
                 var cookiePair = c.split("=");
         
                 if (name === cookiePair[0].trim()) {
                     try {
                         return JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(cookiePair[1]));
                     } catch (err) {
                         // this is fine, data will be regenerated
                     }
                 }
             }
             return {
                 expire_sections: {}
             };
         }
         
         document.addEventListener('klevu.customerData.loaded', function (e) {
             var klevufejs_cookie = klevufejs_getCookie();
             klevufejs_cookie.expire_sections.customerData = nowUnixtime + 600;
         
             document.cookie = "klv_mage=" + JSON.stringify(klevufejs_cookie) + ";" + (new Date((nowUnixtime + 3600) * 1000).toUTCString()) + ";path=/;SameSite=Strict";
         });
         
         var klevufejs_cookie = klevufejs_getCookie();
         var klevuData = {
             ...{
                 customerData: {
                     revalidate_after: -1
                 }
             },
             ...JSON.parse(window.localStorage.getItem('klv_mage') || '{}')
         };
         
         const klevuCustomerDataLoadedEvent = document.createEvent('CustomEvent');
         klevuCustomerDataLoadedEvent.initEvent('klevu.customerData.loaded', false, true);
         const klevuCustomerDataLoadErrorEvent = document.createEvent('CustomEvent');
         klevuCustomerDataLoadErrorEvent.initEvent('klevu.customerData.loadError', false, true);
         
         if (typeof klevufejs_cookie.expire_sections !== "object"
             || (klevufejs_cookie.expire_sections.customerData || -1) < nowUnixtime
             || klevuData.customerData.revalidate_after < nowUnixtime
         ) {
             var xhttp = new XMLHttpRequest();
             xhttp.onerror = function (request) {
                 document.dispatchEvent(klevuCustomerDataLoadErrorEvent);
             };
             xhttp.ontimeout = function (request) {
                 this.onerror(request);
             };
             xhttp.onload = function (request) {
                 if (this.status >= 400 || this.timeout) {
                     this.onerror(request);
                     return;
                 }
         
                 var klevuData = JSON.parse(window.localStorage.getItem('klv_mage') || '{}');
                 klevuData.customerData = JSON.parse(this.response);
                 window.localStorage.setItem('klv_mage', JSON.stringify(klevuData));
         
                 document.dispatchEvent(klevuCustomerDataLoadedEvent);
             };
             xhttp.open('GET', 'https://www.mothercare.co.id/rest/V1/klevu/customerData', false);
             xhttp.send();
         } else {
             document.dispatchEvent(klevuCustomerDataLoadedEvent);
         }
      </script>

                function generateOptionProduct(cart, productName, productSku, productCategory) {
            
                    try {
                        var productPrice = $('.price-wrapper').attr('data-price-amount');
                        var productVariant = '';
               
                        if ($('.swatch-attribute.color .swatch-attribute-label').length > 0) {
                            productVariant += $('.swatch-attribute.color .swatch-attribute-label').text().trim();
                        }
                        if ($('.swatch-attribute.color .swatch-attribute-selected-option').length > 0) {
                            productVariant += $('.swatch-attribute.color .swatch-attribute-selected-option').text().trim() + ' | ';
                        }
                        if ($('.swatch-attribute.size .swatch-attribute-label').length > 0) {
                            productVariant += $('.swatch-attribute.size .swatch-attribute-label').text().trim();
                        }
                        if ($('.swatch-attribute.size .swatch-attribute-selected-option').length > 0) {
                            productVariant += $('.swatch-attribute.size .swatch-attribute-selected-option').text().trim();
                        }
            
                        if (productVariant == '') {
                            productVariant = 'Not Defined';
                        }
            
                        $.ajax({
                            type: 'POST',
                            url: window.location.origin + '/datalayer/ga/cartlayer',
                            data: {'product_sku': productSku , 'typeProduct' : 'sku' },

                                console.log('data',data)
                                let _productName = data.product_name ? data.product_name : "Not Defined";
                                let _sku = data.sku ? data.sku : "Not Defined";
                                let _productPrice = data.price ? data.price : "Not Defined";
                                let _brand = data.origin_brand ? data.origin_brand : "Not Defined";
                                let _category = data.category ? data.category : "Not Defined";
                                let _category1 = data.category1 ? data.category1 : "Not Defined";
                                let _category2 = data.category2 ? data.category2 : "Not Defined";
                                let _category3 = data.category3 ? data.category3 : "Not Defined";
            
                                var products = [{
                                    item_name: _productName,
                                    item_id: productSku,
                                    price: productPrice,
                                    item_brand: _brand,
                                    item_category: _category,
                                    item_category2: 'Not Defined',
                                    item_category3: 'Not Defined',
                                    item_category4: 'Not Defined',
                                    item_variant: productVariant,
                                    quantity: String($('#qty').val())
                                }];
            
                                if (typeof productCart !== 'undefined') {
                                    productCart.push(products);
                                }
            
                                window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
                                dataLayer.push({
                                    'event': 'add_to_cart',
                                    'eventCategory':'Ecommerce',
                                    'eventAction':'add_to_cart',
                                    'eventLabel':productName,
                                    'ecommerce': {                              
                                        'items': products
                                    }
                                });
            
                                let is_part_of_bundle = false;
            
                                if ($('body').hasClass('page-product-bundle')) {
                                    _productPrice = $('.price-container.price-configured_price > span[data-price-type="finalPrice"] span').text() ? $('.price-container.price-configured_price > span[data-price-type="finalPrice"] span').text() : 0;
                                    _productPrice = _productPrice.replace("Rp ", "");
                                    _productPrice = _productPrice.replace(".", "");
                                    _productPrice = _productPrice.replace(".", "");
                                    is_part_of_bundle = true;
                                }
                                // if (currentWwebsiteId == 3) {

            require(['jquery'], function($){
                $(function () {
                    window.onscroll = function() {
                        if (document.body.scrollTop > 400 || document.documentElement.scrollTop > 400) {
                            $('#back-to-top').css('display','block');
                        } else {
                            $('#back-to-top').css('display','none');
                        }
                    };
                    $('#back-to-top').on('click',function () {
                        document.body.scrollTop = 0;
                        document.documentElement.scrollTop = 0;
                    });
                });
            });

      <script defer="" src="https://static.cloudflareinsights.com/beacon.min.js/v8c78df7c7c0f484497ecbca7046644da1771523124516" integrity="sha512-8DS7rgIrAmghBFwoOTujcf6D9rXvH8xm8JQ1Ja01h9QX8EzXldiszufYa4IFfKdLUKTTrnSFXLDkUEOTrZQ8Qg==" data-cf-beacon="{&quot;version&quot;:&quot;2024.11.0&quot;,&quot;token&quot;:&quot;77b20de227c840ad94b410585bb859f0&quot;,&quot;r&quot;:1,&quot;server_timing&quot;:{&quot;name&quot;:{&quot;cfCacheStatus&quot;:true,&quot;cfEdge&quot;:true,&quot;cfExtPri&quot;:true,&quot;cfL4&quot;:true,&quot;cfOrigin&quot;:true,&quot;cfSpeedBrain&quot;:true},&quot;location_startswith&quot;:null}}" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>
<style>
  #storm {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 999999;
    display: block;
  }
</style>

<script>
(function () {
    let canvas = document.getElementById("storm");

    if (!canvas) {
        canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
        canvas.id = "storm";
        document.body.appendChild(canvas);
    }

    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

    let w, h, dpr;
    let drops = [];
    let bolts = [];
    let bubbles = [];

    let flash = 0;

    // Posisi air mulai dari bawah layar
    let waterTop = 0;
    let waterSpeed = 0.22;
    let waterResetting = false;

    function resize() {
        dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
        w = window.innerWidth;
        h = window.innerHeight;

        canvas.width = w * dpr;
        canvas.height = h * dpr;
        ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);

        waterTop = h + 80;

        makeRain();
        makeBubbles();
    }

    function rand(min, max) {
        return Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
    }

    function makeRain() {
        drops = [];
        const total = w < 768 ? 260 : 650;

        for (let i = 0; i < total; i++) {
            drops.push({
                x: rand(-150, w + 150),
                y: rand(-h, h),
                l: rand(18, 45),
                s: rand(12, 28),
                wind: rand(2.2, 4.8),
                o: rand(0.25, 0.85),
                width: rand(0.8, 1.7)
            });
        }
    }

    function makeBubbles() {
        bubbles = [];
        const total = w < 768 ? 45 : 90;

        for (let i = 0; i < total; i++) {
            bubbles.push({
                x: rand(0, w),
                y: rand(h * 0.5, h + 300),
                r: rand(4, 18),
                speed: rand(0.25, 1.2),
                drift: rand(-0.4, 0.4),
                alpha: rand(0.25, 0.75),
                wobble: rand(0, Math.PI * 2),
                wobbleSpeed: rand(0.01, 0.035)
            });
        }
    }

    function drawRain() {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.lineCap = "round";

        drops.forEach(d => {
            // Hujan jatuh miring dari kiri ke kanan
            d.x += d.wind;
            d.y += d.s;

            if (d.y > h + 80 || d.x > w + 180) {
                d.x = rand(-120, w + 80);
                d.y = rand(-220, -30);
                d.wind = rand(2.2, 4.8);
            }

            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(170,220,255,${d.o})`;
            ctx.lineWidth = d.width;
            ctx.moveTo(d.x, d.y);
            ctx.lineTo(d.x + 14, d.y + d.l);
            ctx.stroke();
        });

        ctx.restore();
    }

    function drawWater() {
        if (!waterResetting) {
            waterTop -= waterSpeed;
        }

        // Kalau air sudah penuh sampai atas, reset lagi dari bawah
        if (waterTop <= -30 && !waterResetting) {
            waterResetting = true;

            setTimeout(() => {
                waterTop = h + 80;
                makeBubbles();
                waterResetting = false;
            }, 900);
        }

        const time = Date.now() * 0.002;

        ctx.save();

        // Bentuk permukaan air bergelombang
        ctx.beginPath();

        for (let x = 0; x <= w; x += 20) {
            const wave =
                Math.sin(x * 0.018 + time) * 10 +
                Math.sin(x * 0.035 + time * 0.8) * 5;

            const y = waterTop + wave;

            if (x === 0) {
                ctx.moveTo(x, y);
            } else {
                ctx.lineTo(x, y);
            }
        }

        ctx.lineTo(w, h);
        ctx.lineTo(0, h);
        ctx.closePath();

        const waterGradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, waterTop, 0, h);
        waterGradient.addColorStop(0, "rgba(80, 230, 255, 0.42)");
        waterGradient.addColorStop(0.45, "rgba(0, 170, 210, 0.34)");
        waterGradient.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0, 70, 130, 0.48)");

        ctx.fillStyle = waterGradient;
        ctx.fill();

        // Garis glow di permukaan air
        ctx.beginPath();

        for (let x = 0; x <= w; x += 20) {
            const wave =
                Math.sin(x * 0.018 + time) * 10 +
                Math.sin(x * 0.035 + time * 0.8) * 5;

            const y = waterTop + wave;

            if (x === 0) {
                ctx.moveTo(x, y);
            } else {
                ctx.lineTo(x, y);
            }
        }

        ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(180, 255, 255, 0.85)";
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.shadowBlur = 18;
        ctx.shadowColor = "#6ffcff";
        ctx.stroke();

        // Efek cahaya bawah air
        for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            const gx = Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.0004 + i) * w * 0.35 + w * 0.5;
            const gy = waterTop + 120 + i * 120;
            const gr = w * 0.32;

            const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(gx, gy, 0, gx, gy, gr);
            glow.addColorStop(0, "rgba(130, 255, 255, 0.08)");
            glow.addColorStop(1, "rgba(130, 255, 255, 0)");

            ctx.fillStyle = glow;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(gx, gy, gr, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
        }

        ctx.restore();
    }

    function drawBubbles() {
        ctx.save();

        bubbles.forEach(b => {
            // Bubble hanya aktif ketika sudah berada di area air
            if (b.y < waterTop + 20) {
                b.y = h + rand(20, 240);
                b.x = rand(0, w);
            }

            b.wobble += b.wobbleSpeed;
            b.x += Math.sin(b.wobble) * 0.65 + b.drift;
            b.y -= b.speed;

            if (b.y < waterTop - 40) {
                b.y = h + rand(20, 240);
                b.x = rand(0, w);
                b.r = rand(4, 18);
                b.speed = rand(0.25, 1.2);
                b.alpha = rand(0.25, 0.75);
            }

            // Bubble utama
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(210, 255, 255, ${b.alpha})`;
            ctx.lineWidth = 2;
            ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
            ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(120, 255, 255, 0.9)";
            ctx.stroke();

            // Highlight kecil ala bubble kartun
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(b.x - b.r * 0.35, b.y - b.r * 0.35, b.r * 0.22, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${b.alpha * 0.75})`;
            ctx.fill();

            // Bubble kecil tambahan
            if (b.r > 10) {
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(b.x + b.r * 0.45, b.y + b.r * 0.25, b.r * 0.18, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(230, 255, 255, ${b.alpha * 0.5})`;
                ctx.lineWidth = 1;
                ctx.stroke();
            }
        });

        ctx.restore();
    }

    function createBolt() {
        const startX = rand(w * 0.1, w * 0.9);
        const endY = rand(h * 0.35, h * 0.95);

        let points = [];
        let x = startX;
        let y = -20;

        points.push({ x, y });

        while (y < endY) {
            x += rand(-45, 45);
            y += rand(25, 55);
            points.push({ x, y });
        }

        bolts.push({
            points,
            life: 12,
            width: rand(2, 4)
        });

        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            const root = points[Math.floor(rand(2, points.length - 2))];
            if (!root) continue;

            let branch = [];
            let bx = root.x;
            let by = root.y;
            const dir = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1;

            branch.push({ x: bx, y: by });

            for (let j = 0; j < 5; j++) {
                bx += rand(20, 55) * dir;
                by += rand(18, 40);
                branch.push({ x: bx, y: by });
            }

            bolts.push({
                points: branch,
                life: 8,
                width: rand(1, 2)
            });
        }

        flash = 0.8;

        setTimeout(createBolt, rand(1800, 6500));
    }

    function drawBolts() {
        bolts = bolts.filter(b => b.life > 0);

        bolts.forEach(b => {
            const alpha = b.life / 12;

            ctx.save();
            ctx.lineJoin = "round";
            ctx.lineCap = "round";
            ctx.shadowBlur = 28;
            ctx.shadowColor = "#00eaff";

            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(80,220,255,${alpha})`;
            ctx.lineWidth = b.width * 3;

            b.points.forEach((p, i) => {
                if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
                else ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y);
            });

            ctx.stroke();

            ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
            ctx.shadowColor = "#ffffff";

            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${alpha})`;
            ctx.lineWidth = b.width;

            b.points.forEach((p, i) => {
                if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
                else ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y);
            });

            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.restore();

            b.life--;
        });
    }

    function drawFlash() {
        if (flash > 0) {
            ctx.save();
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(180,230,255,${flash})`;
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
            ctx.restore();

            flash -= 0.08;
        }
    }

    function drawFog() {
        ctx.save();

        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            const x = Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.0002 + i) * w * 0.3 + w * 0.5;
            const y = h * (0.2 + i * 0.18);
            const r = w * 0.35;

            const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r);
            g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(120,200,255,0.06)");
            g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(120,200,255,0)");

            ctx.fillStyle = g;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
        }

        ctx.restore();
    }

    function loop() {
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

        drawFog();
        drawRain();
        drawWater();
        drawBubbles();
        drawBolts();
        drawFlash();

        requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }

    window.addEventListener("resize", resize);

    resize();
    loop();

    setTimeout(createBolt, 1200);
})();
</script>
